title: Big name cannabis stocks sink after more states legalize
summary: Major cannabis stocks, including Canopy Growth and Aurora Cannabis, experienced significant drops after Arizona, Montana, New Jersey, and South Dakota legalized marijuana. title: Lime for Sludge Stabilization Market Outlook to 2035
summary: The global lime for sludge stabilization market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 4-6% from 2026 to 2035, driven by stricter environmental regulations, rapid industrialization, and the expansion of electronics and semiconductor manufacturing. While municipal wastewater treatment remains the largest segment, industrial sludge treatment and high-purity lime demand from semiconductor fabs are experiencing above-average growth. Asia-Pacific is the dominant and fastest-growing region, though the market faces challenges from carbon pricing and energy-intensive production.

title: Delta Air Lines Planning To Leverage AI To Increase Profits By 50%, CEO Says

The airline stressed that this initiative will not lead to immediate job losses and clarified that its AI-powered pricing will not target individuals with discriminatory fares, but rather enhance market competitiveness.
